notes.title: New English dubbing
notes.content:
Hi!
We listen to your complains and manage to hire a new English actress. Now Lucy voices has been dubbed by Lydia Stevens, actress known for the films 'The Colony', 'Haven' or 'Lizzie Borden Took an Ax'.

Thanks for all your oppinions, it make us improve!!

notes.title: Full Controller Support added!
notes.content:
We have added full controller support to Solaria Moon by popular request.
Now you can play the game from start to end using a controller. There are native support for xBox and PS4 controllers.

Looking forward to add more exciting features!!
